headline: Kuura Strand Flares as Nevish Line Holds Hot
war_summary: Three hours on, Kuura Strand furnishes the sharpest turn, logging ten base changes in the last two hours and thirty-one in the day around Menneen, Faden Point and Martti, standing at one Warden and five Colonial holds, where the prior edition recorded no late movement. Marban Hollow has rekindled with four changes in the last two hours and thirty-three in the day at Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall, now two Warden, three Colonial and three neutral. Nevish Line remains hot with three late changes and sixteen in the day at Tomb Father and Blackcoat Way, holding six Warden to two Colonial, backed by 1,360 Colonial and 1,170 Warden casualties in two hours. Weathered Expanse grinds on with two late changes and fifty-five in the day at Frostmarch and Spirit Watch, now four Warden, three Colonial and two neutral. Farranac Coast, Pari Peak and Stonecradle have gone quiet in the last two hours, Linn Mercy shows no late change despite heavy losses, and Callahan's Passage reports heavy casualties with no recorded change.
